note: Magazine fair-market-value index. SAME SCHEMA as fmv_comics.json so the tier ladder, the $ range rendering and the Deep/Full value gates work unchanged. Optional: a 404 leaves the feature dormant and no value renders.
keys: <normalized title>|<key>  — key is the ISSUE NUMBER when the magazine carries one, otherwise the cover date as YYYY-MM. Titles normalize exactly as fmv_comics.json does (_normalizeKeyTitle). Examples: "sports illustrated|1986-07", "mad|27".
curves: Each value is an ascending list of [grade, tier] breakpoints — a step function. The tier is the HIGHEST breakpoint at or below the graded value.
